objects: one complete-card-admitted physical card with fixed ordinary-mana Escape
a fixed set of other owned graveyard cards
costs: one fixed ordinary alternative mana cost plus exactly N other graveyard cards exiled as an additional cost
timing: ordinary timing for the resulting spell
targets: ordinary spell targets are independent from the Escape payment
choices: the owner selects distinct other graveyard cards
hidden_information: graveyard candidates and payments are public
apnap: cost-generated zone events enter the ordinary trigger batch
layers: the shared current-component query gates the graveyard ability
replacement_effects: each fixed cost move uses the canonical destination-replacement owner
copy: copied, granted, text-changed, and repeated Escape forms remain unsupported
control_change: a resolved escaped permanent retains its noncopiable designation across control changes
zone_change: each payment card and the spell become new logical objects through ordinary transitions
source_leaves: the source is excluded from its own other-card cost and stale choices fail before payment

variants: fixed ordinary Escape mana and counts

implementation.supported_slice: One intrinsic fixed ordinary-mana Escape declaration with exactly N other owned graveyard cards exiled as a typed additional cost.

known_blockers: escapes-with counters, abilities, and linked triggered abilities
variable, hybrid, Phyrexian, snow, nonmana, copied, granted, text-changed, repeated, and incomplete-card forms
